text: Return acceptance only after the job and recoverable dispatch intent are durable; identical request replay returns the original job.
criteria: Commit acceptance then fail message publication; recovery publishes the intent and one job remains. Different content under the same key conflicts.

text: Process the immutable selected snapshot, create correct CSV and publish one result reference per job despite redelivery.
criteria: Redeliver a work message and compare row count/order/escaping with reference output; one published result reference exists.

text: Apply the explicit cancellation/success race policy; CANCELLED jobs expose no downloadable result.
criteria: Race cancellation with final publication; exactly one terminal winner exists and CANCELLED never exposes a result.

text: Enforce owner authorization for status/cancel/download and reject filters that exceed the 1000-row bound.
criteria: Another owner cannot inspect/cancel/download; over-1000-row selection is rejected before successful acceptance.

text: Distinguish retriable attempts from terminal failure and expose enough state for an authorized replay/recovery decision.
criteria: Fail after temporary object creation; retry safely resolves or replaces it and records attempt/final state without false success.

text: With 50 jobs of 1000 rows and five configured concurrent workers, complete nominal jobs within five minutes; measure backlog and result correctness.
criteria: Run 50 maximum-size jobs at configured concurrency, compare every CSV and retain completion/backlog measurements.
